insights.title: Apparel drove Q1 uplift; Home flat
insights.summary: Net revenue grew 11% YoY in the last 12-month window, concentrated in Apparel (+18%) while Home held flat (+1%).

anomalies.label: February spike — Apparel
anomalies.detail: Apparel revenue +32% vs prior February; aligns with promo calendar week 7.

caveats: Revenue is net of returns; return lag may understate late-March figures.
8% of orders missing channel tag — regional splits may be biased.

insights.title: January cohort repeat rate
insights.summary: 42% of January buyers placed another order in February (n=18,400 January buyers).
caveats: Cohort uses order presence, not revenue; multi-buyer households may inflate rate slightly.
